theorems.name: Submission.iwl_weighted_tangent_locality
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Eucl P)) (θ θ' : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet M' (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → θ x = θ' x → (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall x ρ) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ∧ IntegrableOn θ' (M' ∩ closedBall x ρ) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ n)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ z in closedBall x (R * r), ‖M.indicator θ z - M'.indicator θ' z‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q ↔ HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' θ' x Q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
